story.title: Jensen Huang to testify before Congress on ‘potential breach of national security’
story.summary: High-stakes hearing comes in wake of resignation from Nvidia after alleged affair with suspected Chinese spy Nvidia’s former CEO Jensen Huang will testify before several congressional committees on 1 December, setting the stage for a high-stakes hearing in the wake of his resignation following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Tim Teter, Nvidia’s general counsel, has also agreed to appear for a closed-door transcribed interview the following day, 2 December. Continue reading...

linkedin.title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone the same.
linkedin.body:
We are drowning in noise. Every day, thousands of stories compete for our attention, but very few of them actually matter to our specific lives or interests. Most algorithms are designed to keep you scrolling by showing you what is popular or inflammatory. They prioritize engagement over substance.

The problem is not that there is too much news. The problem is that the news we get is rarely relevant to who we are. True personalization should not be about creating echo chambers. It should be about filtering out the noise so you can focus on the topics that help you grow, work better, or understand the world around you.

Imagine a feed that learns what you care about and ignores the rest. No clickbait, no outrage farming, just the information you need to stay informed. We think the future of news is about giving you back your time. It is time to move past the one-size-fits-all approach and build something that actually respects your intelligence.

slides.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang to testify before Congress
slides.subtitle: Hearing set for December 1 regarding national security

slides.explanation: This involves the former leader of one of the world's most valuable technology companies. The scope of his testimony will likely impact global semiconductor policy.

slides.headline: Resignation followed allegations of an affair
slides.explanation: The hearing is happening because of his sudden exit after reports linked him to an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
Seven independent news outlets, including the Guardian and TechCrunch, have verified the details of this upcoming congressional hearing.

slides.subtitle: Read the full breakdown on Headlinne.

instagram.caption:
Jensen Huang, the former CEO of Nvidia, is scheduled to appear before several congressional committees on December 1.

The hearing aims to address a potential breach of national security.

This follows Huang's recent resignation from the company. Reports indicate his exit came after allegations of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy surfaced.

Because of Nvidia's central role in the global chip industry, lawmakers are treating this as a high-stakes investigation into sensitive technology and foreign influence.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Ukraine launched a missile and drone attack that caused a partial collapse of the Crimean Bridge.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Ukrainian officials say the complex operation against this strategic target took weeks to plan.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The bridge is a key link for Russia to move supplies into the territory it annexed from Ukraine.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Watch for the Russian response to this strike and the impact on their military logistics.

story_card.caption:
Ukraine has launched a missile and drone attack on the Crimean Bridge causing a partial collapse.

President Zelensky has hailed the operation as an unprecedented strike against Russian infrastructure. The bridge serves as a vital supply line for Russian forces in the annexed region. Military analysts are now watching how this affects the ongoing conflict.
